title: Avoid lowercase allocations in fallback column resolution
description: Replace fallback column-name lowercase allocations in resolve_column_index with allocation-free ASCII-insensitive suffix matching.

criteria: resolve_column_index fallback path no longer lowercases every schema column name.
Fallback matching preserves legacy lowercase-based behavior.

notes: Added a byte-level ASCII case-insensitive suffix helper to avoid UTF-8 slicing boundary panics.
Removed fallback_lower and suffix_lower temporary Strings from production column fallback resolution.
Added unit tests comparing new helper behavior against the previous to_ascii_lowercase matching expression.
